say:1:1033102001:1.text: Patrick misstepped while disembarking and ended up in the water. Everyone only just managed to get him onto land...
say:1:1033102001:1.source_cn: 下船的时候，派瑞克不小心踩空了，掉进了水里，大家好不容...
say:1:1033102001:1.male: Patrick misstepped while disembarking and ended up in the water. Everyone only just managed to get him onto land...
say:1:1033102001:1.female: Patrick misstepped while disembarking and ended up in the water. Everyone only just managed to get him onto land...

say:2:1033102002:1.text: But it's cold and wet here, and we don't have any warm clothes. Poor Patrick's had a fever for several days now.
say:2:1033102002:1.source_cn: 可是这儿又潮湿又冷，我们也没有保暖的衣物，派瑞克已经发...
say:2:1033102002:1.male: But it's cold and wet here, and we don't have any warm clothes. Poor Patrick's had a fever for several days now.
say:2:1033102002:1.female: But it's cold and wet here, and we don't have any warm clothes. Poor Patrick's had a fever for several days now.

say:3:1033102003:1.text: What's more, the Wilders aren't allowing us to enter the forest!
say:3:1033102003:1.source_cn: 而且，绿裔的人还不允许我们进入森林！
say:3:1033102003:1.male: What's more, the Wilders aren't allowing us to enter the forest!
say:3:1033102003:1.female: What's more, the Wilders aren't allowing us to enter the forest!

say:4:1033102004:1.text: Why won't they help when they see a sick child?! Aren't they supposed to be friendly?
say:4:1033102004:1.source_cn: 大人也就算了，但他们看见我可怜的孩子，为什么也不肯帮帮...
say:4:1033102004:1.male: Why won't they help when they see a sick child?! Aren't they supposed to be friendly?
say:4:1033102004:1.female: Why won't they help when they see a sick child?! Aren't they supposed to be friendly?

say:5:1033102005:1.text: If there was a doctor—No, even just a warm and cozy bed, then Patrick would be better in no time.
say:5:1033102005:1.source_cn: 如果能有个医生……不，只要有张温暖舒适的小床，派瑞克肯...
say:5:1033102005:1.male: If there was a doctor—No, even just a warm and cozy bed, then Patrick would be better in no time.
say:5:1033102005:1.female: If there was a doctor—No, even just a warm and cozy bed, then Patrick would be better in no time.

say:7:1033102007:1.text: Dura above, is there anyone out there who can save my child?
say:7:1033102007:1.source_cn: 女神在上，谁能救救我的孩子？
say:7:1033102007:1.male: Dura above, is there anyone out there who can save my child?
say:7:1033102007:1.female: Dura above, is there anyone out there who can save my child?
